Chapter 712 - 712 Killing Bosses?

Chapter 712 - 712 Killing Bosses?

712 Killing Bosses?

In the blink of an eye, another half a year passed.

Lin Fan’s entire body was glowing with a bright light, giving off a holy and vast aura. He was like a god in the heavens, causing people to feel a sense of respect and worship.

Lin Fan took in a deep breath. The surrounding spiritual energy surged into his body in a visible whirlpool.

Then, he turned his attention to the system.

[Host: Lin Fan]

[Cultivation: Level-five Universe]

[Skills: Sword 81 (Emperor), Curse (Emperor), Sword Nurturing Technique (Emperor), Universe Sword Technique (Emperor)…]

[Equipment: Star Meteorite Sword (Ordinary), Flame Armor (Emperor), Heavenly Soul Bead (Emperor), True Dragon Sword (Emperor)…]

[Laws: Time (intermediate), Space (intermediate), Metal (intermediate), Wood (intermediate), Water (intermediate), Fire (intermediate), Earth (intermediate), Life (intermediate), Death (intermediate), Yin (intermediate), Yang (intermediate), Wind (intermediate), Lightning (elementary), Strength (elementary)]

[Character Relationship:]

[Lin Tao: Dad; Favorability: Ten stars]

[Dai Weixue: Mom; Favorability: Ten stars]

[Lin Xiaoyao: Sister; Favorability: Ten stars]

[Xia Xue: Dao companion; Favorability: Ten stars]

[Xia Bing, Dao companion; Favorability: Ten stars]

Even though Lin Fan had been cursing others all these years, he had not neglected his cultivation.

In fact, he had been working even harder.

Coupled with the ever-increasing amount of Immortal Crystals and his top-notch cultivation talent, his cultivation level had reached the fifth level of Universe!

At this moment, a loud sound rang out between heaven and earth.

“Fenghua Sect’s Liu Sanpao is here to challenge the master of Earth, Lin Fan!”

“True Martial Sect’s Hu Yuanyang is here to challenge the master of Earth, Lin Fan!”

“Occult Sect’s Song Hao is here to challenge the master of Earth, Lin Fan!”

…

These voices reverberated throughout the entire Earth and immediately caused many people to discuss.

“Why are there so many people challenging this time?”

“I don’t think I’ve heard of these sects before. How did they spread their names so far?”

“The master of Earth? Lin Fan? Does our Earth really have a master?”

“Lin Fan? It seems to be a name from the Xia Alliance.”

“I think I’ve heard of the name Lin Fan.”

…

When Lin Fan heard that, he frowned and looked up into the sky.

In the air, there were dozens of men and women.

Their auras surged, and their gazes were sharp.

All of them possessed extraordinary strength.

Challenge? Another challenge!

Damn, did they think he was a boss?

Lin Fan’s eyes gleamed as he used his Heavenly Eye to scan over.

Very soon, Lin Fan started shaking his head.

That was because, under the observation of his Heavenly Eye, their bodies were filled with weaknesses. He could easily defeat them.

Even if he was a boss, these people challenging him should have some strength, no?

He would end this farce as soon as possible.

Lin Fan stretched out his index finger.

“Whoosh!”

Immediately, his index finger shot out an endless golden light.

The golden light quickly gathered and condensed into dozens of golden swords. They swept out with a majestic aura.

In the blink of an eye, he arrived in the void.

The target… the dozens of men and women in the air.

Their pupils constricted slightly. Some of them did not even have time to react before they were directly sent flying tens of thousands of miles by the golden swords.

Someone reacted quickly and dodged to the side.

However, the golden swords seemed to have a life of their own. They suddenly changed their direction and struck them again.

Just like that…

These dozens of people came and left in a hurry.

In the blink of an eye, they all disappeared without a trace.

Only dozens of sword marks were left in the air, which seemed to prove that they had been here before.

Lin Fan treated this matter as a small matter and did not take it to heart at all.

However, he still said to his family in the Coiling Dragon Villa, “It’s fine now.”

Hearing this, everyone heaved a sigh of relief.

Hu Tian, who was sitting under the Path-Understanding Tree, hesitated for a moment before slowly walking over.

“Teacher Tiantian, what’s the matter?” asked Lin Fan.

Even now, Lin Fan still addressed Hu Tian as Teacher Tiantian.

It was nostalgic and also a kind of fun.

Hu Tian said, “Lin Fan, Chengzhen seems to have disappeared again.”

“How long has it been?” Lin Fan asked.

“More than a year,” Hu Tian said worriedly.

Lin Fan comforted her, “He has a King-level protection treasure. As long as he’s on Earth, he won’t be in danger. I will see where he is first.”

As soon as he finished speaking, a tidal wave of spiritual energy instantly covered the entire earth.

“Huh?”

Lin Fan frowned.

“What’s wrong?” Hu Tian said nervously.

“I don’t think I saw Chengzhen. That’s strange,” Lin Fan said.

“You didn’t see him?” Hu Tian became even more nervous.

Lin Fan thought about it and said, “Maybe I didn’t see it too clearly. I’ll check it out.”

Following that, his spiritual energy became even more vigorous as he searched the earth inch by inch.

Unfortunately, there was still no trace of Lin Chengzhen.

Hence, Lin Fan used the power of time to search for him.

Finally, one year and three months ago, he found Lin Chengzhen.

He learned that Lin Chengzhen and Li Hao had entered the mystic realm and encountered the mysterious stone pillars.

A moment later, Lin Fan retracted his spiritual energy.

Then, he used the power of soul communication.

Lin Fan called out a few times before Lin Chengzhen finally responded.

“Daddy?”

“It’s me. Where are you and Li Hao now?”

“We don’t know where we are either, but Dad, you and Mom don’t have to worry about me. I’m very safe now. That lord only asked us to cultivate, and I’ve already broken through to the Planet level!”

When Lin Chengzhen said this, there was unconcealable excitement in his tone.

Ever since his younger sister and brother were born, he had always wanted to become stronger.

Unfortunately, becoming stronger was not something he could do just because he wanted to.

Now, his goal was finally realized.

When Lin Fan heard this, he was shocked as well.

He clearly remembered that Lin Chengzhen was only in the Transcendent Realm not long ago, and there was still a long way to go before he broke through to the Star Traveller Realm.

In just a year, he had become a Star Traveller?

Lin Fan asked, “How are you cultivating?”

“The spiritual energy here is very dense. In addition, magical spiritual fruits and spiritual liquids are sent over every week. Oh right, that lord also taught us a powerful cultivation technique. Dad, let me tell you about this cultivation technique,” Lin Chengzhen said.

Lin Fan thought for a moment and said, “Alright.”

Thus, Lin Chengzhen told him everything about the cultivation technique.

The cultivation technique was very complicated. It was only said once, and ordinary people would not be able to remember it.

However, Lin Fan was not an ordinary person.

Lin Fan said, “Cheng Zhen, do you know the name of the lord you’re talking about?”

“I heard someone call him Moses,” Lin Chengzhen said.
